default path: the 2D underlay and the 3D picture each go in once, as PNG, packed FAST (alias left undefined)
default path: underlay on the frame, 3D picture at frame + ExportRectMm (positions unchanged)
ExportSheet with two arguments exports: returns true, toasts "PDF downloaded."
ExportSheet hands the save { returnPromise : true }
default path skips a missing drawing source and a failed 3D render and still builds the document
every clip opened is closed (default path)
VV's paint path kept: the viewports draw bottom layer first, hidden layers skipped, then sheet markup, then chrome
the linework is still asked for with the viewport's Model Source: EnsureLinework(definition, null, false, modelSource)
options.pictureCompression (a string) is handed to jsPDF for every viewport picture
a pictureCompression that is not a string falls back to FAST
strict false (the publisher shape) skips a missing source and builds
strict: a 2D viewport with no drawing source throws 'A viewport drawing source is missing.' and closes its clip
strict: a 3D viewport whose render failed throws 'A 3D viewport could not be rendered.' and closes its clip
ExportSheet hands its options to BuildDocument: strict on the missing source returns false, logs and toasts the failure; without options it exports
the toast waits for the save: nothing toasted while the save is pending, "PDF downloaded." after it resolves
a save that fails is reported: false, failure toast, console error
LoadLibrary answers the jsPDF already on the page and injects nothing
one script for every concurrent caller, async, at the configured jsPDF path; all resolve to the same constructor
a script that fails rejects with 'jsPDF failed to load from <path>' and the next call tries again
EnsureJsPdf passes LoadLibrary's failure on: 'jsPDF did not register'
no import of the exporter was left unstubbed
